set.body: Parent epic: bd-01KR8ZJJ8W882F1S9JWE06K741. Add scale_space_twosample(subject_images, group, ...) as a thin wrapper using fixed-size label permutations and Welch statistic by default. Documentation must state that simple label permutation assumes exchangeability and is not the preferred route for unbalanced clinical/control or nuisance-adjusted analyses. Tests: wrapper matches manual low-level call and validates two-level groups.
set.title: Scale-space: two-group raw-image wrapper
